basic_profile.bio: Living in Portland, Oregon, RetroSonicWave is a 28-year-old sound engineer passionate about remixing and electronic music production. With a love for alternative rock and indie bands, their playlist frequently features Glass Animals, Tame Impala, and more. They work at a local music studio and often spend evenings experimenting with new sounds. In a committed relationship, they balance work and leisure, often engaging with the Reddit community during late-night hours. Dislikes include mainstream pop and formulaic music production.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: RetroSonicWave has a degree in Audio Engineering and has been working professionally for over six years. They have honed their skills through both formal education and extensive self-teaching, using online tutorials and forums to master new software and techniques.
